Some Applications

Some applications developed with this software are:

  • Mesh Compression
    Jarek Rossignac. "Edgebreaker: Connectivity Compression for Triangle Meshes", In IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics, v. 5, n. 1, 47-61, 1999. (PDF)
  • Surface Reconstruction
    Esdras Medeiros and Luiz Velho and Hélio Lopes. "A Topological Framework for Advancing Front Triangulations", In Proceedings of SIBGRAPI. IEEE Press, 2003. (PDF)
  • Subdivision Surfaces
    Leif Kobbelt. "sqrt{3} Subdivision", In Proceedings of SIGGRAPH 2000, Computer Graphics Proceedings - Annual Conference Series, 103-112, 2000.
  • Multiresolution Structures for Terrain Moldeling
    Luiz Velho, Lourena Rocha, Sergio Pinheiro, and Marcelo Vieira. "Visualizacao de Terrenos em Tempo Real com Malhas Semi-Regulares". Technical Report TR-2004-05, Laboratorio VISGRAF, 2004 (PDF)
